title: Encapsulation: class Product
text: Hehe Groceries wants to keep its products in objects. Create class Product with these private attributes:
bullets: productId (String), productName (String), productPrice (int), productStock (int)
A public constructor that fills all four attributes, and a public getter for each attribute
A method getTotalValue() that returns productPrice x productStock
In Main: read an integer N, then N lines in the format ID;Name;Price;Stock. Store every product in an ArrayList<Product>
Print each product as:  PR001 | Indomie Goreng | Rp 3500 x 40 = Rp 140000
Finally print:  Total inventory value: Rp <sum of all total values>

PR002 | Teh Botol Sosro | Rp 5000 x 24 = Rp 120000

title: Access modifiers: fix class Member
text: The starter code does not compile because Main touches Member's private attributes directly. Fix it without making any attribute public:
bullets: Keep name and points private. Do NOT add a setPoints() method
Add public methods: getName(), getPoints(), addPoints(int amount) and boolean redeemPoints(int amount)
addPoints ignores amounts <= 0. redeemPoints returns false (and changes nothing) when the amount is <= 0 or larger than the current points
Input: the member name (one line), N, then N commands: ADD <amount> or REDEEM <amount>
After ADD print:  Points: <current points>
After REDEEM print:  Redeemed <amount> points   or   Failed to redeem <amount> points
At the end print:  <name> has <points> points

4

REDEEM 30

reqs.label: name and points are still private

title: Inheritance: Employee, Cashier, Supervisor
text: Create a parent class Employee and two child classes:
bullets: Employee: protected name (String) and baseSalary (int), a constructor, int calculateSalary() that returns baseSalary, String getRole() that returns "Employee", and display() that prints:  <role> - <name> - Rp <salary>
Cashier extends Employee: extra attribute shiftCount. Salary = baseSalary + shiftCount x 75000. Role = "Cashier"
Supervisor extends Employee: extra attribute bonusPercent. Salary = baseSalary + baseSalary x bonusPercent / 100 (integer math). Role = "Supervisor"
Both child constructors must call super(...)
Input: N, then N lines  C;Name;BaseSalary;ShiftCount  or  S;Name;BaseSalary;BonusPercent
Store everyone in one ArrayList<Employee>, call display() for each, then print:  Total salary: Rp <total>

reqs.label: Employee's name and baseSalary are protected

title: Abstraction & polymorphism: shopping cart
hint: abstract class, abstract method, polymorphism, printf
text: Every item in the cart gets a different discount. Create:
bullets: abstract class Item with private name (String) and price (double), getters, abstract double getDiscountRate(), and double getFinalPrice() = price - price x getDiscountRate()
Food extends Item (discount 10%), Beverage extends Item (discount 5%), Household extends Item (15% when price >= 50000, otherwise 0%)
Input: N, then N lines  F;Name;Price  /  B;Name;Price  /  H;Name;Price
Keep them in one ArrayList<Item> and print each one as  [<ClassName>] <name>: Rp <price> -> Rp <final price>  (2 decimals)
Finally print:  Total to pay: Rp <total>  (2 decimals)

title: Interface: payment methods
text: The cashier accepts several payment methods. Create interface Payment with a constant ADMIN_FEE = 2500 and two methods: double pay(double amount) and String getMethodName().
bullets: Cash implements Payment: pays exactly the bill. Name "Cash"
DebitCard implements Payment: pays the bill + ADMIN_FEE. Name "Debit Card"
EWallet implements Payment: 2% cashback (pays bill - 2%) when the bill >= 100000, otherwise pays the bill. Name "E-Wallet"
Input: lines  <CODE> <amount>  until the word END. CODE is CASH, DEBIT or EWALLET
For each valid line print:  <method name>: bill Rp <amount>, paid Rp <paid>  (2 decimals)
For an unknown code print:  Unknown payment method: <CODE>  (the amount is still read and skipped)
At the end print:  Transactions: <count>, total paid: Rp <total>  (2 decimals)

DEBIT 75000
EWALLET 120000
EWALLET 99999.5

END
expect: Debit Card: bill Rp 75000.00, paid Rp 77500.00

title: ArrayList: daily sales report
text: Read today's sales amounts (positive integers) until the number 0, and store them in an ArrayList<Integer>.
bullets: If there is no data, print  No data  and stop
Otherwise print, one per line:  Count: <n>,  Sum: <sum>,  Average: <avg with 2 decimals>,  Highest: <max>,  Lowest: <min>
Then remove every amount that is below the average from the list, and print:  At or above average: <list>  (use the ArrayList's toString, e.g. [300, 150])

title: Data structures: checkout queue with undo
text: Simulate the checkout line. Customers wait in a queue (first come, first served); served customers are pushed to a stack so the last serve can be undone.
bullets: JOIN <name>  -> add to the back of the queue, print  <name> joined the queue (size: <size>)
SERVE  -> take the front customer, push them on the stack, print  Serving <name>   (empty queue: No customers in queue)
UNDO  -> pop the last served customer and put them back at the FRONT of the queue, print  <name> is back at the front   (empty stack: Nothing to undo)
SHOW  -> print  Queue: <queue>  (toString of the queue, e.g. [Andi, Budi])
EXIT  -> stop and print  Customers served: <stack size>

SHOW

SERVE
SERVE

SHOW

SHOW

Insert - category: "Input product category [Food | Beverage | Household]: " (case sensitive, repeat until valid)

Exit prints  Thank you for using Hehe Groceries!

title: Exceptions: checkout with a custom exception
hint: extends Exception, throw, throws, try-catch, multi-catch
text: Stock must never go negative. Create a checked exception and use try-catch in Main:
bullets: class OutOfStockException extends Exception, with a constructor that receives the message and passes it to super(...)

In Product add  public void buy(int qty) throws OutOfStockException :  qty <= 0 throws an IllegalArgumentException("Quantity must be positive"); qty > stock throws  new OutOfStockException("Not enough <name>: only <stock> left");  otherwise stock decreases
Input: N, N lines  Name;Stock,  then M, M order lines  Name;Qty  (the product name is matched ignoring upper/lower case)
Unknown product -> print  Product not found: <name>
Qty that is not a number -> print  Invalid quantity: <text>  (catch NumberFormatException)
Success -> print  Bought <qty> <name>, <stock> left    Failure -> print  Failed: <exception message>
Finally print  Remaining stock:  followed by  <name>: <stock>  for every product (input order)

title: Sorting & searching an ArrayList
text: Read N products (Name;Category;Price), then commands until the line END:
bullets: Product has private name, category, price and a toString() that returns  <name> (<category>) - Rp <price>
SORT PRICE  -> sort the list by price ascending (equal prices: by name) and print every product
SORT NAME  -> sort the list by name, ignoring upper/lower case, and print every product
SEARCH <keyword>  -> print (in the current list order) every product whose name contains the keyword, ignoring case; if none print  No product matches '<keyword>'
CHEAPEST <category>  -> print  Cheapest <category>: <product>  or  No product in <category>

title: CRUD + inheritance: Hehe Membership
hint: abstract class, polymorphism, ArrayList<Member>, set, remove
text: A second exam-style app. Members are Regular (5% discount) or VIP (15%). Menu: Hehe Membership / 1. Register Member / 2. View Members / 3. Upgrade Member / 4. Remove Member / 5. Exit / >>  (bad input shows the menu again)
bullets: abstract class Member with private id, name, phone, getters, abstract String getType() and abstract int getDiscount(). RegularMember and VipMember extend it
Register: "Input name [3-20 characters]: ", "Input phone [starts with 08, 10-13 digits]: " (only digits), "Input member type [Regular | VIP]: " (case sensitive). Repeat each until valid
ID = MB + 3-digit counter starting at 001, then print  Member <ID> registered!
View: empty -> No members yet!  otherwise a table in insertion order:  | No | ID | Name | Phone | Type | Discount |  e.g.  | 1 | MB001 | Budi | 081234567890 | Regular | 5% |

Upgrade: show the table, "Choose member to upgrade [1-N]: " (repeat until valid). If the member is already VIP print  Member <ID> is already VIP  otherwise replace it in the list with a VipMember that keeps the same id, name and phone, and print  Member <ID> upgraded to VIP!
Remove: show the table, "Choose member to remove [1-N]: ", then  Member <ID> removed!
Upgrade/Remove on an empty list only print  No members yet!   Exit prints  Bye!
